# Assembly — llms.txt
# https://assembly-murex.vercel.app/llms.txt

> Assembly is a free multi-agent AI consensus platform. One question plus a time
> budget forms a temporary team of AI agents that solve independently,
> cross-examine, verify with web sources, and synthesise one final answer with
> numbered sources and an uncertainty note. Users bring their own free API keys
> (BYOK). No accounts, no login, nothing stored on the server.

## Docs

- [Home](https://assembly-murex.vercel.app/): what Assembly does and how it works
- [Ask](https://assembly-murex.vercel.app/chat): ask a question and run Assembly
- [Setup](https://assembly-murex.vercel.app/settings): add free provider API keys
- [History](https://assembly-murex.vercel.app/executions): past runs on this device

## Key facts

- Time budgets: 3, 5, 10 or 15 minutes (hard cutoff).
- Providers: Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, Hugging Face (free tiers, models.yaml).
- Web history lives in the browser (IndexedDB). No server-side user storage.
- Some free tiers (for example Gemini) may use inputs for model improvement.
- Consensus is scored; weak consensus is stated as uncertain, never promised correct.
